The reason this is relevant is because of how energy from the sun comes to us. When emitted from the sun the energy/heat is in the form of high frequency radiation. When that energy hits planets, including earth, it is absorbed and then reemited. The big deal is that its reemitted in the form of infrared radiation. Infrared radiation is low frequency, long wavelength.

So think about the Earth. Sun hits our atmosphere in the form of high frequency radiation and mostly passes right on through. But when it is absorbed and reemitted back off the earth it comes back in a low frequency form of radiation that CO2 does a good job of blocking some chunk of it and keeping it trapped inside our atmosphere resulting in a warming effect.
